extracted.name: Fresh Tomato Zucchini Soup
extracted.description: This fresh tomato zucchini soup recipe with onion and garlic features tarragon and dill, stewed into a summer dish that pairs great with crusty bread.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh red chile pepper
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add zucchini and garlic; cook and stir until lightly browned. Off heat, set aside.
Combine tomatoes, onion, and chile pepper in a blender or the bowl of a food processor; pulse until puréed, leaving a few small chunks.

Combine tomato purée and vegetable broth in a large pot; season with tarragon, dill, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and stir in zucchini-garlic mixture. Cover; cook for 45 minutes.
